newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania to sue tobacco industry.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania to sue tobacco industry.

text.p: The state of Pennsylvania will file suit Wednesday against the tobacco industry, a spokesman for state Attorney General Mike Fisher said.
Spokesman Sean Duffy said he could not discuss details of the suit, but that it would be in line with those filed by other states against the industry.
"We're doing what the other states are doing," he said.
Details of the suit would be discussed at a state capitol news conference in Harrisburg, he said.

Duffy said it had not yet been decided whether Pennsylvania would join a settlement reached last month with the Liggett Group, owned by Brooke Group Ltd, by attorneys general for 22 states that had sued the industry.
"We're going to court and we have not decided whether we will join the Liggett settlement," he said.
